title: carlina bollei
intro: Carlina bollei, commonly known as the Carline Thistle, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, digestive issues, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carlina bollei include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with pain, fever, and infection. The bioactive constituents of Carlina bollei include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
